title: A keyword in the description links the pull request to the issue
setup: New branch t01 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t01 → Create pull request → description: Closes #N (real number) → Create pull request.
Pull requests tab → open it. Look at: Open/Merged/Closed, issue it will close.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

final_check: The pull request page lists issue N as one it may close. The issue's side panel shows the pull request. ASSUMPTION: the exact wording on the screen is not in the spec.

title: Uppercase keyword with a colon works
setup: New branch t04 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t04 → Create pull request → description: CLOSES: #N (capital letters, a colon, the real number instead of N) → Create pull request.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

title: A word that is not on the keyword list
setup: New branch t15 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t15 → Create pull request → description: Closing #N (real number) → Create pull request.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

final_check: The issue is still Open. ASSUMPTION: the word Closing is not a keyword.

title: A keyword written in a comment, not in the description
setup: New branch t16 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t16 → Create pull request → description: plain text (no keyword) → Create pull request.
open the PR → comment box at the bottom → type: Closes #N (real number) → Comment.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

final_check: ASSUMPTION: the issue is still Open.

title: A keyword on a pull request into another branch does nothing
setup: New branch t03 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: other, compare: t03 → Create pull request → description: Closes #N (real number) → Create pull request.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

final_check: The issue shows no linked pull request, and after the merge it is still Open.

title: Removing the keyword unlinks the issue
setup: New branch t07 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t07 → Create pull request → description: Closes #N (real number) → Create pull request.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).
open the PR → three dots on the description → Edit → delete the text, type "no keyword" → Update comment.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

final_check: After the edit the issue shows no linked pull request. After the merge the issue is still Open.

title: Merging the linked pull request closes the issue
setup: New branch t02 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t02 → Create pull request → description: Closes #N (real number) → Create pull request.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

title: Two issues, each with its own keyword, both close
setup: New branch t05 (P1b). Create two open issues: do P2 twice. Write down both numbers (N and M).

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t05 → Create pull request → description: Closes #N, closes #M (the real numbers) → Create pull request.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed.
Issues tab → #M. Look at: Open/Closed.

title: One keyword for two issues closes only the first
setup: New branch t06 (P1b). Create two open issues: do P2 twice. Write down both numbers (N and M).

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t06 → Create pull request → description: Closes #N, #M (one keyword, two real numbers) → Create pull request.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed.
Issues tab → #M. Look at: Open/Closed.

final_check: Issue N is Closed. ASSUMPTION: issue M stays Open.

title: A merge that mentions an issue that is already closed
setup: New branch t12 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2). Close it: open the issue → Close issue. (A6)

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t12 → Create pull request → description: Closes #N (the real number of the closed issue) → Create pull request.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

final_check: ASSUMPTION: the merge works, the issue stays Closed and no error is shown. The test fails if the merge fails or the issue opens again.

title: Closing the pull request without merging leaves the issue open
setup: New branch t13 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t13 → Create pull request → description: Closes #N (real number) → Create pull request.
open it → Close pull request (bottom of the page).
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

final_check: The issue is still Open. ASSUMPTION: not stated in the spec.

title: A keyword for an issue number that does not exist
setup: New branch t14 (P1b). You do not need an issue. Pick a number much higher than the number of issues you have, for example 9999.

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t14 → Create pull request → description: Closes #9999 → Create pull request.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Pull requests tab → open it. Look at: Open/Merged/Closed, issue it will close.

final_check: ASSUMPTION: the pull request is created and merged, and no issue is changed. The test fails if creating or merging gives an error.

title: A keyword in a commit message closes the issue on merge
setup: New branch t08 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: Code tab → branch t08 → open a file → pencil icon → change one word → Commit changes → message: Fixes #N (real number) → Commit changes.
Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t08 → Create pull request → description: plain text (no keyword) → Create pull request.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

final_check: The issue is Closed. ASSUMPTION: GitHub reads the keyword from the commit message when the pull request is merged.

title: A commit-message keyword does not show the pull request as linked
setup: New branch t09 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: Code tab → branch t09 → open a file → pencil icon → change one word → Commit changes → message: Fixes #N (real number) → Commit changes.
Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t09 → Create pull request → description: plain text (no keyword) → Create pull request.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).
Pull requests tab → open it. Look at: Open/Merged/Closed, issue it will close.

final_check: The issue does not list the pull request as linked. The pull request page lists no issue it may close. ASSUMPTION: the second part is not stated in the spec.

title: Closing an issue in another repository
setup: New branch t17 (P1b). Create an open issue in the second repository and write down its number. NEEDS HOW: the second repository.

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t17 → Create pull request → description: Fixes OWNER/REPOSITORY#NUMBER (the real owner name, repository name and number of the issue in the second repository) → Create pull request.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.

steps.what: Check the issue in the second repository
steps.how: Issues tab → its number.

final_check: The issue in the second repository is Closed.

title: A keyword that points to a pull request comment
setup: New branch t19 (P1b). Open a second pull request on its own branch. NEEDS HOW.

steps.what: In the second pull request, copy the link of one comment. NEEDS HOW.

steps.how: Pull requests tab → New pull request → base: main, compare: t19 → Create pull request → description: Fixes (the link of the comment) → Create pull request.
open the PR → Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
Pull requests tab → open it.

final_check: The second pull request is Closed.

set: Who can close an issue, and why
title: The reason for closing is saved
setup: New branch t11 (P1b). Open issue, write down N (P2).

steps.how: open the issue → small arrow next to Close issue → write down the list.
arrow next to Close issue → pick a reason that is not the first → Close issue. NEEDS HOW: which reason.
Issues tab → #N. Look at: Open/Closed, side panel (linked PR).

final_check: The issue is Closed and shows the reason you chose. ASSUMPTION: the reason is shown on the issue.
